_note: 东方增补地名表 — the lands past the edge of the Latin mappa mundi. Same schema as fatequest-worldmap/data/cities.geojson properties; merged by scripts/build_worldmap.py. Coordinates are real (EPSG:4326); medieval names follow the Yule–Cordier Polo, Ibn Battuta and Chinese sources. CC0.

cities.note: 刺桐港 — Polo calls it one of the two greatest havens in the world for merchandise
大都 — the Great Khan's winter capital
行在 — the City of Heaven, twelve thousand bridges by Polo's count
上都 — the summer capital and its cane palace
扬州 — Polo claims to have governed here three years
南京 — later the yard where Zheng He's treasure ships were laid down
广州 — the older of the southern havens, worked by Arab and Persian factors
沙州 — where the desert road forks and the caves are cut
喀什噶尔 — the oasis where the northern and southern rims of the Taklamakan meet
于阗 — jade from the two rivers
哈剌和林 — the tent-capital Rubruck reached in 1254
巴尔赫 — the mother of cities, still in ruins when Polo passed
巴达赫尚 — the balas-ruby mines and the high cold air Polo credits with curing him
亚兹德 — silk called Yasdi, and the desert of Kerman beyond
克尔曼 — turquoise, steel and the wearisome road to the sea
古里 — pepper port of Malabar; Zheng He's fleets anchored and his stele stood here
坎贝 — indigo and cotton cloth out of Gujarat
俱蓝 — brazilwood, ginger and the Nestorian church of St Thomas
锡兰 — rubies, the peak with the footprint, and pearls in the gulf
满剌加 — the strait every monsoon must pass through
苏门答剌 — where Polo waited five months for the wind
爪哇 — pepper, nutmeg and cloves; the Khan never took it
基尔瓦 — the gold of Sofala came north through here; Ibn Battuta called it finely built
木骨都束 — cloth and camel-meat; a stop for both Battuta and Zheng He
泽拉 — the crossing to Arabia, which Battuta judged the foulest-smelling town on earth
旧忽鲁谟斯 — the mainland town before the island took the trade
马斯喀特 — where the Gulf gives way to the ocean and the monsoon
佐法儿 — frankincense country

seas.note: 涨海 — the junk sea, worked on the monsoon clock
榜葛剌海 — crossed only with the wind behind you
the spice waters; nutmeg and cloves grow nowhere else

regions.note: 契丹 — the Khan's north, reached overland
蛮子 — the conquered Song south, reached by canal and sea
唐兀 — the corridor between desert and mountain
马八儿 — pearl fishery and the shrine of St Thomas
南毗 — pepper and the ships that come for it

ranges.note: 帕米尔 — twelve days without habitation; Polo says fire burns pale up there
